name: Planet Fighter Transfer and Citadel Read Regression
description: Ownership, capacity, atomic fighter accounting, and treasury visibility for planetary APIs.

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, population, colonists_unassigned, fighters, citadel_level) VALUES (977701, 1, 'Fighter Transfer QA', @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'player', 'M', 1, @{admin_player_id}, 0, 0, 50, 1) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type='player', fighters=50, citadel_level=1;

INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, treasury, owner_id, construction_status, target_level, construction_start_time, construction_end_time, planetaryShields, militaryReactionLevel, qCannonSector, qCannonAtmosphere) VALUES (977701, 1, 555, @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'idle', 0, 0, 0, 100, 1, 50, 40) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1, treasury=555, construction_status='idle', target_level=0, construction_start_time=0, construction_end_time=0, planetaryShields=100, militaryReactionLevel=1, qCannonSector=50, qCannonAtmosphere=40;
UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Land owner ship and set fighters

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE, fighters=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Fixture enslaved population with existing assignments

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET population=1000, population_type='SLAVE', colonists_unassigned=400, colonists_ore=300, colonists_org=200, colonists_eq=100, colonists_weapons=0 WHERE planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Prepare exact harvested stocks and a five-hold ship

data.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});
UPDATE ships SET ore=0, organics=0, equipment=0, holds=5 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES (977701,'ORE',0,100000,0),(977701,'ORG',0,100000,0),(977701,'EQU',0,100000,0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET max_capacity=100000;

INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES ('planet',977701,'ORE',2,0),('planet',977701,'ORG',3,0),('planet',977701,'EQU',4,0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: Harvest transfers only stock that fits without turns
Harvest state conserves all goods and syncs ship cargo

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='ORE')=0 AND (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='ORG')=0 AND (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='EQU')=4 AND s.ore=2 AND s.organics=3 AND s.equipment=0 FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.ship_id=s.ship_id WHERE pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Owner sees current citadel state, defenses, and treasury
Owner overview includes treasury without management internals
Transfer fighters from ship to planet
Transfer fighters from planet to ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships s SET fighters=st.maxfighters FROM shiptypes st WHERE s.type_id=st.shiptypes_id AND s.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Assert capacity refusal did not change fighter counts

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=st.maxfighters FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;
UPDATE ships SET fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Reject transfer exceeding available ship fighters

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=0 FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;
UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id};
UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id});

tests.name: Landed visitor does not receive treasury balance
Landed visitor overview omits treasury and ownership data
Owner emancipates the whole population without cost
Emancipation preserves assigned and unassigned counts

data.sql: SELECT population=1000 AND population_type='COLONIST' AND colonists_unassigned=400 AND colonists_ore=300 AND colonists_org=200 AND colonists_eq=100 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Landed visitor cannot transfer planet fighters

tests.name: Prepare evil-aligned landed player and SLV cargo

data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment=(SELECT min_align FROM alignment_band WHERE is_evil=TRUE ORDER BY min_align LIMIT 1),lastplanet=977702,sector_id=1 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Load slave cargo and land at destination

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=TRUE,holds=10 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'SLV',2 FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} ON CONFLICT (ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=2;

tests.name: Evil player deposits slaves as slave population
Slave delivery consumes cargo and does not mix population

data.sql: SELECT p.population=2 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=2 AND COALESCE(sc.quantity,0)=0 FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} LEFT JOIN ship_cargo sc ON sc.ship_id=pl.ship_id AND sc.commodity_code='SLV' WHERE p.planet_id=977702;
UPDATE players SET alignment=0 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};
